KATSANA is proud to announce the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with MARA LINER SDN. BHD. towards advancing the digitalisation of fleet operations and maintenance management across their transportation ecosystem. Through this collaboration, Katsana and MARA Liner will work together to implement a unified platform that combines Fleet Management System (FMS) capabilities with a Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) — enabling greater visibility, operational efficiency, preventive maintenance planning, and data-driven decision making for MARA Liner buses as well as their heavy vehicle customers. As public transportation and heavy vehicle operations continue to evolve, digital infrastructure plays an increasingly important role in improving reliability, safety, compliance, and cost efficiency. This collaboration reflects a shared commitment to modernising fleet operations with scalable technology that supports long-term operational growth. We are honoured to support MARA Liner’s growth plans and transformation journey, and we look forward to building impactful solutions together for the transport and heavy vehicle industry in Malaysia. A sincere thank you to the MARA Liner leadership and team for the trust and opportunity. #Katsana #MARALiner #FleetManagement #CMMS #DigitalTransformation #SmartFleet #Telematics #HeavyVehicles #PublicTransport #MalaysiaTech #MobilityTechnology
